pr_body:
This makes it possible to use every core available for checksumming, which makes a huge difference for large tree artifacts.

Fixes #17009.

RELNOTES: None.
PiperOrigin-RevId: 525085502
Change-Id: I2a995d3445940333c21eeb89b4ba60887f99e51b (cherry picked from commit 368bf117513731909337b6e2bd5082c046399506)

## Context 
This is an attempt at cherry-picking this change to 6.2.0 as described in this comment: https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/368bf117513731909337b6e2bd5082c046399506#commitcomment-110335567

Not totally sure if this is the right approach or there are more parts missing, but at least it built locally for me.
pr_comment: @keertk : mind merging this into 6.2.0? It's a backport of the fix for #17009 which needed to be backported and tweaked because it doesn't apply cleanly here

Branch: release-6.2.0rc2
Commit: https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/96eb991242746dc62a7cf85a07da26db09e5bcf2

We are seeing a regression on 6.2.0rc2 and looks like it might be related to this change. 

**Bazel 6.1.0**
![Screenshot 2023-05-05 at 4 41 51 PM](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11925399/236585329-b6f29ce7-cf5d-4d78-880e-226cef19e8d6.png)


- actuallyCompleteAction: 1.3seconds

**Bazel 6.2.0**
![Screenshot 2023-05-05 at 4 42 51 PM](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11925399/236585387-59fc34b6-abc1-47df-abe2-66cd64374af3.png)

- actuallyCompleteAction: 6.7seconds
@chiragramani would you mind opening an issue for this so we can track it separately?

@chiragramani Can you include some steps to reproduce the potential performance regression in the issue?

/cc @lberki

I did 3 tries before this change and after, and here are the results of how long the `actuallyCompleteAction` in our bundling step of our app took (which is a tree artifact).

Before: 9.3s, 6.4s, 9.8s
After: 4.2s, 5.5s, 4.5s

So in our case we definitely see an improvement after this change. All measurements were performed by applying the same incremental modification to a single module, causing it to link and bundle the app again  I’ve noticed a big variance in these measurements from our developers as well after being on this change for a few days. Sometimes for the same exact change it can take 20s to compute the metadata, and other times it can take 4s.
I would hope that once we have migrated to JDK20, and start using loom things like this become a lot easier to manage. cc @coeuvre
